name: ADS-B Exchange (NZ Public Safety)
description: Ingests real-time ADS-B aircraft position data from ADSBExchange, with optional supplementary tar1090/ADSBX-compatible feeds, and posts aircraft tracks to the map, with special handling for NZ public safety aircraft.

permissions.description: Submits aircraft position CoT features to CloudTAK

schedule.description: Polls ADSBExchange and any configured supplementary feeds for updated aircraft positions on a schedule.
